messages:
Asha (growth): Heads up — saw ~170 leads stuck in 'unassigned' last hour after enrichment latency spike. Pattern: HubSpot enrichment webhook times out, RR code skips assignment. Anyone else seeing claim stalls? :frowning:
Evan (salesops): saw that too, our SF sync doubled requests. Can you paste sample webhook id? @Marcus
Asha (growth): webhook id `wh_0a9d3f`, logs show 504 from enrichment-api for ~2m. timestamped at 15:03 UTC
Marcus (revops): that matches our anomaly window. HubSpot retries are configured to 3x with 30s backoff; when enrichment fails the lead lands in queue and RR ignores it because `metadata.enrichment_complete` missing.
Jules (devex): quick patch idea — change RR to fallback-to-default-owner if enrichment pending > 45s. Pseudocode:
```
if (!enrichment_complete && age > 45s) assign(default_owner)
else route_round_robin()
```
Nina (marketing): webinar signups impacted, about 30 from last promo. Can we backfill owners for the last 2 hours? Need follow-up emails sent today.
Marcus (revops): I can run a backfill job to assign by timestamp window and trigger SF lead owner update. Will need a lead list from HubSpot query.
Asha (growth): thanks. @HubSpot Sync Bot can you export leads with `hs_createdate >= 2026-03-22T14:00:00Z AND owner IS NULL` ?
HubSpot Sync Bot: Export started, will DM CSV when ready. :gear: 
Evan (salesops): For the longer term let's add an observability metric `lead.claim_skips` and alert at 50/min. Also add SLA: mean claim time < 20s and 95% < 60s.
Jules (devex): On it — will open a PR to add fallback + metric + unit test. Rolling deploy canary to marketing channel first.
Marcus (revops): I'll coordinate backfill and notify outbound team. ETA 90m.
Asha (growth): great — temporary owners + email follow-ups. Postmortem later if it reappears. :thumbsup: 
Evan (salesops): small follow-up — update docs runbook 'inbound-handshake' with steps to backfill and how to toggle fallback flag.
Jules (devex): added checklist in /docs/marketing/inbound-runbook.md (internal). PR coming.
Asha (growth): closing loop — will post summary to #marketing after backfill completes.
